editorialPolicy: AARAMORA is a multilingual discovery catalogue. It links to official sources and records language scope, access model, provenance, accessibility notes and item-level rights caveats. It does not mirror copyrighted books, scrape restricted sites, bypass access controls or treat a collection-level statement as a book-level licence. Language filters are discovery aids, not a guarantee that a linked source contains every listed language.

languageGroups.label: India · Eighth Schedule (22 languages)
languageGroups.scope: All 22 languages listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India. This group is a constitutional list, not a complete inventory of India's languages.

languageGroups.label: India · additional regional-language discovery
languageGroups.scope: Additional Indian languages and language varieties represented in institutional discovery catalogues or included as further discovery filters. Availability must be checked in the source catalogue; this list is not exhaustive.

languageGroups.label: World languages · initial discovery filters
languageGroups.scope: An expandable starting set for international-language discovery. These are filter terms, not a claim that every linked catalogue contains resources in every language.

languageGroups.label: Classical and scholarly text languages
languageGroups.scope: Languages represented in scholarly and cultural text collections. Availability and rights are title-specific.

records.title: National Digital Library of India (NDLI)

contributors.name: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur / Ministry of Education, Government of India

records.languageCoverageLabel: NDLI browse facets and its contents-in-Indian-languages page list overlapping Indian-language discovery categories, including Assamese, Awadhi, Bengali, Bhojpuri, Bodo/Boro, Dogri, Garo, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Khasi, Konkani, Maithili, Malayalam, Manipuri/Meitei, Marathi, Mizo, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Santali, Sinhala, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu. These are portal-level discovery terms, not proof of a specific book in every language.

access.label: Discover at NDLI · access and downloads vary by provider
access.notes: NDLI aggregates metadata from numerous institutions; many resources remain at their original provider. Some content is freely accessible, some is licensed to registered users, and downloads are available only when the content provider permits them. Do not treat an NDLI language facet as proof of a particular book or edition.

rights.jurisdiction: Depends on the contributing institution and exact item
rights.reuse: No redistribution permission is inferred from an NDLI catalogue record.
rights.notes: NDLI's FAQ confirms that some copyrighted resources are available through provider licensing, that NDLI does not host all linked content, and that downloads depend on provider permission.

accessibility.screenReaderNotes: Check the linked provider page. Do not assume a scanned PDF is searchable or screen-reader accessible.

provenance.sourceName: National Digital Library of India · IIT Kharagpur

verification.method: AARAMORA checked the named source page and its public access or rights notes. This does not verify every individual title or edition.

records.title: Heritage Scripture Server · IIT Kanpur
records.editionTitle: Structured Sanskrit source texts, translations, commentaries and transliterations

contributors.name: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur · Heritage project

records.languageCoverageLabel: Sanskrit source text, with selected transliteration and translation layers. The server documents 11 scripts; verify the language of each individual record.

access.label: Read at source · API key required for most API endpoints
access.notes: Use the public reader or request an API key. API calls are subject to published rate limits and the Heritage Content Access Licence.

rights.jurisdiction: Rights vary by source text, translation and commentary
rights.reuse: Ancient Sanskrit moolam and transliterations derived only from source texts are public domain. Modern translations and commentaries remain copyrighted; stated non-commercial use requires full attribution. No bulk harvesting or loss of provenance.
rights.notes: Do not apply source-text status to translations, commentaries, AI drafts or community works. Keep attribution close to any permitted use.

records.editionTitle: Work, edition, author and library-loan catalogue
records.languageCoverageLabel: Search the catalogue by language and inspect the exact edition record.

access.label: Discover editions; borrow only where a loan is offered
access.notes: A catalogue entry is not proof of a downloadable file. Digital lending uses publisher/library controls and may be time-limited.

rights.licence: Metadata and book files have separate rights
rights.reuse: Use the official API for human-directed discovery, cache results and identify your application. Do not scrape HTML or make bulk single-book requests. For bulk metadata, use monthly data dumps or contact Open Library.
rights.notes: Open Library's API documentation says it is not intended as a bulk data backend or high-traffic commercial infrastructure.

records.languageCoverageLabel: Punjabi / Gurmukhi source material; check the individual interface for transliteration and translation options.

access.label: Open BaniDB and review its service terms
access.notes: AARAMORA links to BaniDB only. It does not copy or integrate the Gurbani database.

rights.licence: BaniDB Terms of Service and NPOSL-3.0 (subordinate to service terms)
rights.jurisdiction: Service terms and applicable copyright law
rights.reuse: Do not mirror or integrate data without first obtaining and reviewing required written permissions and accepting the service obligations. Terms specify use of the full Gurbani dataset if integrated, database refresh within 90 days, BaniDB acknowledgement and logo, and monthly contribution requirements or financial contribution in lieu.
rights.notes: BaniDB terms also restrict reproduction, redistribution and commercial use without written permission. A public API endpoint is not a blanket data licence.
